[EN] Siria,

Your unbridled passion for investigating the Omphalos Plains is truly admirable, but the fact remains that it's crawling with kumases and nagas and I can't protect you. My soldiers don't lack for courage, but I won't throw them away so you can satisfy your intellectual vanity!

Please heed this warning and return to Godric's Farm or the Sanctum Mysterium.

Centurion HerothPut away the letter.
[ES] Siria,

Tu pasión desenfrenada por investigar los Omphalos Plains es verdaderamente admirable, ¡pero el hecho es que está plagado de kumases y nagas y no puedo protegerte! Mis soldados no carecen de valor, ¡pero no voy a desperdiciarlos solo para que satisfagas tu vanidad intelectual!

Por favor, presta atención a esta advertencia y regresa a Godric's Farm o al Sanctum Mysterium.

Centurión HerothPut away the letter.
